* Internally relies on {@link View#setTranslationX} and {@link View#setTranslationY}. *

* Note: translations on pages are not reset when this adapter is changed for another one, so you * might want to set them manually to 0 when dynamically switching to another transformer, or * when switching ViewPager2 orientation. * * @see ViewPager2#setPageTransformer * @see CompositePageTransformer
